capabilities: Find every *.sync-conflict-* file in the vault
Open each conflict next to its original as a Meld tab
Merge changes into the original files
Delete confirmed conflict files via a checklist
Configure the Meld executable path in settings
extras: Desktop only; does not work on mobile because it launches an external program and reads and deletes files. On Windows, a very large number of conflicts could exceed the command-line length limit.
problem: Syncthing leaves conflict copies alongside originals when devices edit the same file, and Obsidian offers no way to review and clean them up.

relations.evidence: Resolve Syncthing sync conflicts in your Obsidian vault with Meld.
The plugin only deletes files matching Syncthing's conflict naming pattern

summary: Conflict resolver that collects Syncthing *.sync-conflict-* files in the vault, opens them as Meld diff tabs, and deletes the ones you confirm.
